description: Generate or adapt AI caption suggestions for one or more social platforms. Uses AI Caption Assist quota and returns options only; it does not create or schedule posts. After the user chooses final copy, pass it to create_post or create_posts_batch.

brief.description: What the post is about. Recommended for generate mode.

manual_brand_voice.description: Use when posterly asks for brand voice input.

platforms.description: Target platforms such as instagram, linkedin, twitter, tiktok, youtube, pinterest, or google_business.

social_account_id.description: Optional connected account ID for brand voice and workspace billing context.

source_caption.description: Required when mode=adapt. The master caption to adapt.

name: generate_captions
